{{Top|leg}}

'''Metaxas root''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that could be ground up into a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] white powder. Ingestion of only a few granules was all that was required to kill most targets. Metaxas powder was fine, odorless, flavor-less, and fast-acting. To reverse the effects of the poison, a gray powder [[Antidote/Legends|antidote]] had to be taken at most thirty seconds after poisoning. During his [[Mission to Cog Hive Seven|mission]] to [[Cog Hive Seven]], [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] sprinkled metaxas root powder in a [[Dakarai Blirr|prisoner's]] [[Traladon steak|food]] and offered the antidote in exchange for vital information.
